text: Sean McIntyre, Acting Manager, Poverty Reduction Strategy Office, Social Development and Finance Administration Division, will provide an update on the recently Council-approved Toronto Poverty Reduction Strategy - 2019-2022 Action Plan. http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2019.EX10.1 . This update is provided in response to a request from the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee at its June 4, 2019 meeting.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends to the Executive Committee that: 1. The Deputy City Manager, Community and Social Services report to the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee in the fourth quarter of 2020 on developing a Persons with Disabilities Poverty Reduction Action Plan.
